items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Garbage Rogers from Chicago... he was a big, big shot in Chicago... I remember one time they came into Parsons... he needed my father's smoking jacket

ctx.x: Oh, so I mean that would be a big trip to come, I mean....
Well, there used to be minstrel shows, like Billy King Minstrel Show which had my father's cousin Garbage Rogers from Chicago, he was.....
How, what was that first name?
